messages:
Ana (CS): FYI — Cascade Health asked us to onboard a customer-trained clinical summarization model. They flagged PHI and tokenization quirks. They want evals + SAFETY review. Copying SE/ML.

Devon (Solutions): Can you paste the model config + size? Are they expecting hosting on Dedicated or Private?

Ana (CS): From CX: model is 'cascade-summarizer-v1' (fine-tuned on customer records), 7B, fp16->quant 4-bit, private deployment (VPC) requested. Customer wants latency <= 220ms P95.

Omar (ML Eng): we'll need sample artifacts + prompt templates + eval dataset (redacted). Also need to run safety suite and red-team tests. Can they provide synthetic PHI replacements? Also note prefix tokens from EHRs produce long context.

Beth (Safety): PHI handling mandatory: client must pre-process with K-anonymization + KMS keys. We'll need Data Handling Agreement signed. Any policy exemptions?

Ana (CS): Customer is Cascade Health (HITRUST-certified). They provided a small eval set (100 cases) — sanitized. Upload link: https://redir.cascade/samples/abc123 (access limited).

Devon (Solutions): I'll spin a Private env; @deploy-bot can you create a sandbox VPC: cascade-vpc-abc123, tagged 'cs-onboard'?

deploy-bot: Created infra ticket #INF-4421. VPC ready in staging in ~4h.

Omar (ML Eng): Quick check — are we allowed to load customer-trained weights into hosted? For Private yes. For Dedicated maybe compliance issue. Plan: run eval harness:

```bash
python eval/harness.py \
  --model-path /mnt/cascade/weights \
  --eval-set cascade_eval.json \
  --metrics rouge_l,bleu,contradiction_rate \
  --safety-suite config/safety.yml
```

Beth (Safety): Add tests for PHI leakage: named-entity leakage rate, context-restore test. Thresholds: leakage_rate < 0.5%.

Omar (ML Eng): Got it. I'll run baseline in staging and share numbers by EOD. Estimate 3-5hrs.

Ana (CS): Customer asked about cost/throughput: expected 5000 summaries/day peak. Ask finance for estimate.

Devon (Solutions): Noted. @Mark (Eng-Infra) any special routing for prioritized lanes? We'll set a dedicated pool.

Mark (Eng-Infra): Can allocate a 2-GPU pool with 80GB A100 for now. Autoscale policy can be conservative. I'll link cost estimate.

deploy-bot: Ticket updated #INF-4421 -> assigned to eng-infra.

Omar (ML Eng): Quick heads up: eval results (sanitized): ROUGE-L 0.62, BLEU 0.44, contradiction_rate 0.03, PHI_leakage 0.12% — passes safety thresholds but need more red-team.

Beth (Safety): Initial thumbs up. Schedule red-team with @security_lab. Also require KMS integration verification.

Ana (CS): I'll send customer the first pass and timeline. Thanks team :heart:
